Civitai 会员和所有酷炫的 Canuck PolarisFX 周围的人对 AegisFlow 的赞扬：

宙斯盾流是一个面向项目的工作流程，专为那些需要在系统中自动生成各种概念的资产的人而设计，该系统可以自动处理项目/文件命名并保持想法的组织性。它是分段排列的，并且在搜索正确的种子/条件/设置时可以将许多部分静音。

然后，当您准备好时，重新启用这些部分以生成调色板、艺术线条、后处理和其他输出。

它有超过 22 页（并且还在不断增加）的手册，清晰而专业地解释了其使用方法，是了解基本 SD 功能和原理的良好资源。在这里查看一下。

大多数物品都是由开关控制的；不再像使用旧的模拟合成器机架那样接线和重新接线。

例如，下面的 (3) 启用或禁用迭代升频器。

对抗错误的最佳方法是查看 22 页的 AegisFlow 手册，位于GitHub或获取工作流程古姆路

v.a6 的重大变化！现在是 Windows 安装程序，只有 5.5GB！这是完整安装，减去 2 个模型、2 个 VAE 和 2 个 controlnet 模型。

新的说明提供了这些额外资源的直接链接，并告诉您将它们放置在哪里。

需要在数字交付上预先配置吗？

我现在有一个定制安装，包含您出售所需的一切在 Gumroad 上售价 15 美元。这将安装自定义 ComfyUI 环境，为您提供带有图标的桌面和程序文件快捷方式等等。

这也允许我创建基于 exe 的补丁，我事先对其进行了测试，这样您就不必花费所有时间与 python 作斗争，而将更多时间花在生成图像上。

我还不断扩展工作流程并添加实用程序工作流程。付费安装程序更新将包括所有这些，而基本免费工作流程则不会。

到目前为止，有四个可链接的工作流程（和工作流程模板），允许您将面部细节器/修改器、创意蒙版和特效系统以及迭代升级器链接在一起。还有一个“保存程序”模板，您可以使用它来保存结果，或将其连接到简单的“保存图像”节点。

需要在 USB 上预先配置吗？

对于那些想要预配置的即插即用解决方案的人，我提供了 256gb MicroSD 卡，对于现金多于时间的人来说，它具有开箱即用的体验，并且还具有各种检查点、LoRas 等。

它配备了功能齐全的 Windows ComfyUI 安装、所有依赖项、额外的内容，当然还有工作流程，所有这些都整齐地排列和组织。我会在每张卡离开之前对其进行测试，以确保所有文件都复制良好并且您能够立即生成。

执照

截至目前（v.a7），此工作流程已获得 MIT 许可。欢迎您出于 MIT 许可证允许的任何目的以任何方式安装、使用、扩展或更改它。我希望您不要只是下载它并按原样转售，或者假装是您制作的，但我也无法阻止您:)。如果我看到滥用行为，我可能会修改许可，但总的来说，我想保持人工智能社区的开放精神，同时也为自己和家人赚钱。谢谢！

o.en:
Praise for AegisFlow From Fellow Civitai member and all around cool Canuck PolarisFX:

AegisFlowis a project-oriented workflow designed for those needing to auto-generate assets for various concepts in a system that handles project/file naming automatically and keeps ideas organizable. It is sectionally arranged, and many sections can be muted while searching for just the right seed/conditioning/settings.

Then re-enable the sections to generate palettes, lineart, post-processed, and other outputs when you're ready.

It has a 22+ page (and growing) manual that explains its use clearly and professionally, and is a good resource for understanding basic SD features and principles.Check it out here.

Most items are switch-controlled; no more wiring and rewiring as if you're using an old analog synth rack.

For Example, (3) below enables or disabled the iterative upscaler.

The best way to fight back against the bugs is to check out the 22-page AegisFlow manual located atGitHubor get the workflow atGumroad

Big Changes for v.a6! Now a windows installer, and only 5.5gb!!! This is a full install, minus 2 models, 2 VAEs, and 2 controlnet models.

New instructions give direct links to these extra resources, and tell you just where to place them.

Need it preconfigured on Digital Delivery?

I now have a custom installation with everything you need for saleon Gumroad for $15. This installs a custom ComfyUI environment, gives you a desktop and program files shortcut with icon, and much more.

This also allows me to create exe-based patches, which I test beforehand, so that you won't have to spend all your time fighting pythons and more time generating images.

I'm also continually extending the workflow and adding in utility workflows. The paid installer updates will include all these, while the base free workflow will not.

So far, There are four chainable workflows (and workflow templates) that Allow you to chain together a facial detailer/modifier, a creative mask and fx system, and an iterative upscaler. There's also a "saver" template that you can use to save your results, or wire it to a simple "save image" node.

Need it preconfigured on USB?

For those that want a preconfigured, plug-n-go solution Ioffer a 256gb MicroSD card that has an out-of-box experience for those with a bit more cash than time, and also has a wide assortment of checkpoints, LoRas, etc.

It comes with a fully functioning Windows ComfyUI install, all dependencies, extra stuff, and of course the workflows, all neatly arranged and organized. I test every card before it leaves to ensure that all files copied well and that you'll be able to generate right away.

License

As of now (v.a7), this workflow is MIT licensed. You are welcome to install it, use it, extend it, or change it in any way, for any purpose that the MIT license allows. I'd prefer that you don't just download it and resell it as is, or pretend you made it, but I can't stop you either :). If I see abuse of this, I might modify the licensing but in general I want to keep the open spirit of the Ai community, while also making money for myself and family. Thanks!
